page.overview:
Who is Zomara?

Zomaran are slender, beautiful, youthful, and always smiling. They have golden hair and blank, dead black, empty eyes. They wear tight white breeches and flowing white blouses and move with disturbing grace.

Although zomaran do come in male and female genders, they appear so androgenous that it is difficult to tell the difference. Although they are able to read minds, they are of low intelligence and cannot speak.

They also have an engineered memory capacity such that anything other than commands fade from their consciousness after a few minutes. Like other Shadowspawn, they were created by Aginor.

The True Power was presumably involved, something maybe hinted at by the fact they have eyes of pure black. If this is the case, it may be possible that the Dark One himself can access their eyes and ears, although this is speculation. If they are simply constructs of the One Power, the apparent use of human stock would still make them one of his more perverse creations and violate all kinds of ethics and Age of Legends restrictions to limit genetic modification to plant life. Aran'gar said she "hated the creature's ability to know what was in her head," although glad that it did not have the ability to communicate whatever it found there. This is particularly useful in a setting where secret plotting may be going on. She believes that Moridin must have found a stasis box full of them.
